tip.en: The run opens at 1007m. Today is 3.21km versus your recent 3.8km average, so the workload profile is already different.
tip.zh: 这次从 1007 米起步。今天是 3.21 公里，而你最近平均约 3.8 公里，训练负荷从一开始就不同。

tip.en: Heart rate tops out at 163 here, which is the physiological price tag of this run.
tip.zh: 这里的心率来到峰值 163，可以理解为这次跑步付出的生理代价。

tip.en: This is the steepest uphill patch at 1.9km. Grade hits 36.6%, and the run asks for force rather than rhythm here.
tip.zh: 这里是最陡的上坡段，位于 1.9 公里处。坡度达到 36.6%，这里更考验力量，而不是节奏。

tip.en: The route crests here at 1140m. This is less about “the summit” and more about where the whole run changes character.
tip.zh: 路线在这里来到 1140 米的高点。它不只是“最高点”，更是整次跑步性格发生变化的位置。

tip.en: The steepest descent arrives here at -16.5%. This section rewards confidence and punishes braking.
tip.zh: 最陡下坡出现在这里，坡度 -16.5%。这段会奖励顺势而下，也会惩罚用力刹车。

tip.en: Your quickest section appears here at about 3:16/km. The route finally gives you permission to move.
tip.zh: 你最快的区间出现在这里，约 3:16/公里。路线终于允许你把速度放出来。

tip.en: You close at 7:31/km overall, quicker than your recent 8:11/km baseline.
tip.zh: 最终均配 7:31/公里，和你最近 8:11/公里 的基线相比，今天更快。
